name: Budapest
tagline: The world's most beautiful café, and the ruin bar that invented an entire nightlife genre.

Costes.description: Hungary's first restaurant to win a Michelin star, contemporary French cuisine in District IX.

Szimpla Kert.description: Budapest's oldest ruin bar, a garden-bar inside a derelict building in the Jewish Quarter.

New York Café.description: Considered the world's most beautiful café, with gilded ceilings and crystal chandeliers since 1894.

Stand.description: The pinnacle of contemporary Hungarian haute cuisine, Budapest's only two-Michelin-star restaurant.

Nagyvásárcsarnok (Gran Mercado Central).description: Budapest's largest and oldest covered market, since 1897, with lángos and Hungarian cold cuts on the upper floor.
